headline: Surana Solar announces voting results for its 20th Annual General Meeting
summary: Surana Solar has released the formal voting results following the conclusion of its 20th Annual General Meeting. Shareholders reviewed and voted on standard resolutions presented during the meeting. The filing completes the mandatory compliance process for the company's annual gathering. Retail investors track these outcomes to ensure governance resolutions pass without unexpected shareholder dissent.
why_it_matters: Standard AGM compliance update with no direct financial impact
